args.sql_query:
-- Summary of pipeline execution by data source type
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN "pk_products 1 4_bronze_silver_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 'Products'
        WHEN "pk_sales_data 1 4_bronze_silver_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 'Sales Data'
        WHEN "pk_stores 1 4_bronze_silver_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 'Stores'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS data_source_type,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count,
    MIN(load_timestamp) AS first_load,
    MAX(load_timestamp) AS last_load,
    COUNT(DISTINCT source_filename) AS unique_files
FROM pipeline_execution_report
GROUP BY data_source_type
ORDER BY record_count DESC

-- Detailed breakdown by source file
SELECT 
    source_filename,
    CASE 
        WHEN "pk_products 1 4_bronze_silver_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 'Products'
        WHEN "pk_sales_data 1 4_bronze_silver_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 'Sales Data'
        WHEN "pk_stores 1 4_bronze_silver_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 'Stores'
    END AS data_type,
    COUNT(*) AS records_processed,
    load_timestamp AS processed_at
FROM pipeline_execution_report
GROUP BY source_filename, data_type, load_timestamp
ORDER BY data_type, records_processed DESC

-- Overall pipeline summary
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS total_records_in_gold,
    COUNT(DISTINCT source_filename) AS total_source_files,
    MIN(load_timestamp) AS pipeline_start_time,
    MAX(load_timestamp) AS pipeline_end_time,
    COUNT(DISTINCT 
        CASE 
            WHEN "pk_products 1 4_bronze_silver_id" IS NOT NULL THEN "pk_products 1 4_bronze_silver_id"
        END
    ) AS unique_products,
    COUNT(DISTINCT 
        CASE 
            WHEN "pk_sales_data 1 4_bronze_silver_id" IS NOT NULL THEN "pk_sales_data 1 4_bronze_silver_id"
        END
    ) AS unique_sales_transactions,
    COUNT(DISTINCT 
        CASE 
            WHEN "pk_stores 1 4_bronze_silver_id" IS NOT NULL THEN "pk_stores 1 4_bronze_silver_id"
        END
    ) AS unique_stores
FROM pipeline_execution_report
